translation.english_text: (The judgment is read.) Pandiyan came only after hearing the news through the newspaper! The testimony of the owner of Sivasakthi Mill and the hospital watchman makes it clear that he had no connection whatsoever with the murder. It is not believable that he committed the murder merely because there was enmity between Paranthaman and Pandiyan! Therefore Pandiyan is acquitted. (Poomaal smiles.) Poomaal, who admits to the crime of murder, is sentenced to death.
Newspaper News: 'Elder sister killed younger brother.'
notes: The corrected source prints this newspaper heading at the opening of scene 92. It was historically attached to scene 91; this new scene-92 unit restores the corrected source boundary without renumbering any surviving historical unit.
